question: When did Chernobyl nuclear disaster take place?  (RRB JE CBT I (30/05/2019) Shift 2)
options: 1986
1990
1982
1984
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1986

Explanation:
The Chernobyl nuclear disaster occurred on April 26, 1986 at the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant in the former Soviet Union (now Ukraine). It is considered the worst nuclear accident in history, classified as Level 7 (major) on the International Nuclear Event Scale. The explosion happened in Reactor No. 4 due to an uncontrolled chain reaction during a safety test, releasing massive amounts of radioactive material into the atmosphere. Thousands of people suffered from radiation sickness, and vast areas were contaminated, leading to long-term health and environmental consequences. This disaster prompted major reforms in global nuclear safety protocols.

☛ Location of Chernobyl plant → Ukraine (then USSR)
☛ Cause of accident → Reactor design flaw and human error
☛ Severity level → INES Level 7 (major)
☛ Evacuation zone → 30 km exclusion zone declared

question: Which of the following two banks merger with Bank of Baroda was effective from 1 April 2019?  (RRB JE (29/05/2019) Shift 3 CBT 1)

question: Virupaksha Temple, which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is dedicated to the deity- (RRB JE (29/05/2019) Shift 3 CBT 1)
options: Krishna
Ganesh
Shiva
Vishnu
solution:

Explanation:

The temple is situated on the banks of the Tungabhadra River.

question: Which of the following is a folk dance of Rajasthan? (RRB JE CBT I (31/05/2019) Shift 1)
options: Bhangra
Garba
Nati
Ghoomar
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Ghoomar

Explanation:
Ghoomar is the famous folk dance of Rajasthan, primarily performed by the Bhil community and other tribes. This dance is performed in a circular motion and is done by women on special occasions. Bhangra is a folk dance of Punjab, Garba of Gujarat, and Nati of Himachal Pradesh. In Ghoomar, women wear red or saffron costumes and twirl while performing. It has been declared the state dance of Rajasthan and is performed during festivals, weddings, and celebrations.

question: What is the driving force and executive body of the European Union (EU)? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (04/02/2021) Shift 2)
options: court of Auditors
Council of the European Union
European Parliament
European Commission
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is European Commission

Explanation:
The driving force and executive body of the European Union (EU) is the European Commission. It proposes and implements EU policies, ensures compliance with EU laws, and manages the EU budget. The Commission consists of 27 members (one from each country), known as Commissioners. Its headquarters is in Brussels, Belgium. The Commission represents the interests of the EU and works alongside the European Parliament and the Council. Other options: Court of Auditors handles financial audits; Council of the European Union represents ministers of member states; European Parliament is the legislative body.

question: Who among the following is India's first civilian space tourist? (RRB JE CBT-I 2024 (16/12/2024) Shift 1)

question: Chaitanya Mahaprabhu was related to which of the following religious sects? (RRB JE CBT-I 2024 (16/12/2024) Shift 1)
options: Vaishnava
Shaiva
Kapalika
Tantra
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Vaishnava

Explanation:
Chaitanya Mahaprabhu (1486-1533) was a prominent Vaishnava saint and reformer. He founded Gaudiya Vaishnavism, centered on devotion to Lord Krishna. He popularized the practice of sankirtan (congregational chanting). Born in Bengal, he spent most of his life in Jagannath Puri. His teachings are based on the philosophy of achintya bheda-abheda, which accepts both distinction and unity between the devotee and the Lord. Among the other options, Shaiva worships Lord Shiva, Kapalika is a tantric sect, and Tantra is related to esoteric practices. Thus, Chaitanya Mahaprabhu belonged to the Vaishnava sect.

☛ Who founded Gaudiya Vaishnavism? → Chaitanya Mahaprabhu
☛ Which devotional practice did Chaitanya Mahaprabhu popularize? → Sankirtan
☛ Where was the main center of Chaitanya Mahaprabhu? → Jagannath Puri
☛ What is the philosophy of Chaitanya Mahaprabhu called? → Achintya Bheda-Abheda
